info.name: ilist Websites API Documentation
info.description:
ilist Websites API documentation, allows developers of Real Estate Websites, to synchronize properties of a Real Estate Agency that use ilist CRM, with the website of the Agency.

All API Calls should be made to the following API-URL: https://ilist.e-agents.gr

Each API Call should contain the AuthenticationToken in the header as Simple Authentication.

For example:

key : authorization

value: d33db979-e6cf-4661-9e65-94fff50ecca6

“value” is a unique key that the Agency can create from their ilist account and provide it to you (The key indicated in this documentation is for testing only).

All API Calls will return the same json response with a structure as indicated below, where “data” is the relevant data model, depending on the call you have made.

{
  "code": null,
  "success": true,
  "total": 0,
  "data": [object],
  "nextPage": null,
  "error": null
}

API Limitations

In order to protect the system from receiving more data than it can handle and to ensure an equitable distribution of the system resources, there are limitations on the number of calls that each Real Estate Website can make.

The limit is 10 API Calls (GET, POST, etc) per minute.

In case this limit is exceeded, the appropriate error will be returned.

request.description:
A POST Call that accepts criteria/search fields as BODY and returns properties that meet these criteria.

You can set the maximum number of results as well as the page you want to get with the URL variables pagesize and page respectively.

The maximum number of results is 100.

To get the results of the next page, you can use the returned URL to the variable nextPage, by sending again a POST Call, with the same criteria in the BODY.

Characteristics contains a list of all the characteristics/features of the property. The list of available features of the application can be seen by calling [List] PropertyCharacteristics.

All features related to lookup values will have the related category (lookup) in the LookupType field, and in Value you will find the relevant Ids that correspond to each option, separated by commas!

With the Header Variable Details, you can define the breadth of data you wish to get, in favor of speed.

The isSync value (true/false) that is returned with each property, indicates whether a property is synced on the Agency’s Website and there have been no changes to its features/characteristics from the previous API Call you have made, or not.

StartFragment

Similarily, any call that includes the isSync variable in its BODY, will return either old properties (for isSync=true) or only those that need to be synced, depending on the selected isSync value.

EndFragment

NOTE: Using the isSync=false variable, you must not change pages if the results are greater than 100 records. Because after each call, the returned properties will be marked as synced, so the next call will not include that properties. You should just request the first page of the isSync=false until the feed is empty!

The suggested process is to make a POST Properties Call with isSync: false, so that you get only the properties that are out of sync (new uploads, updated properties, etc) with the Agency’s Website. All properties that you get with the suggested process, will automatically turn to isSync: true and you will not get them in your next API Call.
